title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Pineapple Ice Nic Salt e-liquid blends the tropical taste of ripe, juicy Pineapple with a refreshing Menthol breeze. The tangy sweetness of the Pineapple is perfectly complemented by the crisp, cooling sensation of Menthol on the exhale, delivering a refreshing and satisfying vape. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid offers smooth throat hits and quick nicotine relief, providing a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this flavour offers an all-day vape experience with a tropical twist. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand known for their exciting e-liquid creations. The Pukka Juice 5000+ collection takes the vibrant flavours of disposable vapes and puts them into a versatile, reusable format. Other flavours to explore include Berry Blast, Blue Sour Razz, and Raspberry Pomegranate.
